Studio modular assets and retained Handshake integration

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: **[STU-PRO-174] Slide timing folded into Pulse.** The source `timing` record has required `type` exactly `ON_CLICK` or `AFTER_DELAY`, and optional `delay: number` explicitly in seconds. Raw source absence and zero are different and MUST round-trip distinctly. Any source runtime normalization that ignores/resets delay for `ON_CLICK` is separate from the preserved raw projection and must cite its profile; an example value is not a default. Pulse converts source duration/delay into the existing integer 254 016 000 000-ticks-per-second time base using checked range/conversion and explicit rounding/loss metadata, retains raw seconds and provenance, and never inherits prototype-millisecond bounds. Native playback/manual advance, skipped-slide traversal, timer cancellation and deterministic ordering reuse the existing presentation/interaction scheduler and bounded admission path; realtime callbacks must not perform blocking diagnostics or database work. Shared Controls, typed commands, Argus snapshots and both manual layers expose authored timing, effective timing and cancellation outcomes. No feature implementation is accepted until its affected timing and overflow cases are proven.

materialized_acceptance.text: Pin the actual SlideTransition/timing declaration and affected source runtime profile/fixture before a version-specific normalization or fidelity claim. Required type is exactly ON_CLICK or AFTER_DELAY; delay is optional number in seconds. Keep the Plugin API 1.141.0 commit 07157d96c58add71d234b13bfd55b53abdce76b8 declaration provenance separate from current 2026-10-10 documentation normalization whose pinned-version applicability is UNVERIFIED until the original runtime fixture resolves it. Round-trip raw authored timing with exact type token, presence of delay, numeric seconds and source/version provenance. Missing delay, explicit zero and explicit nonzero remain distinct; ON_CLICK raw delay survives even when a separately identified runtime profile ignores or resets its effective value. No new default, invented precision/step or prototype-millisecond bound is applied.

Convert source duration and effective delay seconds using the existing canonical integer tick field at exactly 254016000000 ticks/second. Check finite numeric input, representable range, intermediate multiplication/addition and destination deadline before conversion; emit deterministic explicit rounding/loss metadata and preserve raw seconds. Reject unrepresentable inputs without clamp, wrapping, widened stored schema or float timing authority. Resolve the existing stored type and approved rounding policy before implementation rather than inventing a sign/range.

Deliver native timing behavior through the existing presentation/interaction scheduler and bounded admission ports. ON_CLICK advances only through accepted explicit manual advance; AFTER_DELAY follows the resolved source/native profile for absent/zero/nonzero delay. Exercise skipped-slide traversal, same-deadline ordering, manual/timer races, stale callbacks, cancellation, revocation, backpressure, drain and restart with immutable identity/revision; reject or cancel stale work rather than retarget it.

Realtime timer callbacks perform only bounded scheduling/notification work through existing owners. No blocking database, diagnostic, logging or allocation-heavy capture path enters the callback. Capture typed timing/cancellation outcomes outside it; prove bounded cancellation/admission and deterministic event order under load against an independent controlled clock/event oracle, then measure the affected actual callback path.

Expose authored raw timing, effective ticks/profile/rounding/loss, manual-advance availability and cancellation outcome through existing typed commands, shared Controls descriptors and Argus inspection contracts. Update canonical asset UserManual and the later host internal UserManual through the same descriptor source; truthful usage, units, missing/zero semantics, error recovery and diagnostic posture match the executable behavior. Actual native captures, error scan, constrained/edge states and quiet interaction remain MT-36200 host proof.

Pass focused executable standalone proof on the owned public Pulse contract with exact dependency/features/toolchain/artifact isolation, independent original profile and numeric/scheduler oracles, all affected timing/overflow negatives and public loss/cancel output. Publish the allowlisted source to canonical assets GitHub with immutable release/dependency digests and independently re-read the remote source before any separate MT-36200 host adoption. acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pin the actual SlideTransition/timing declaration and affected source runtime profile/fixture before a version-specific normalization or fidelity claim. Required type is exactly ON_CLICK or AFTER_DELAY; delay is optional number in seconds. Keep the Plugin API 1.141.0 commit 07157d96c58add71d234b13bfd55b53abdce76b8 declaration provenance separate from current 2026-10-10 documentation normalization whose pinned-version applicability is UNVERIFIED until the original runtime fixture resolves it. Round-trip raw authored timing with exact type token, presence of delay, numeric seconds and source/version provenance. Missing delay, explicit zero and explicit nonzero remain distinct; ON_CLICK raw delay survives even when a separately identified runtime profile ignores or resets its effective value. No new default, invented precision/step or prototype-millisecond bound is applied.

Convert source duration and effective delay seconds using the existing canonical integer tick field at exactly 254016000000 ticks/second.
